guides.values_1: All pet values are community-driven and update regularly based on real trading data.
guides.values_2: Values are shown for Default (D), Neon (N) and Mega Neon (M) versions.
guides.values_3: Demand scores (🔥) show how popular a pet currently is with traders.
guides.values_4: Use search and filters to quickly find any pet, egg, vehicle or toy.
guides.values_5: Trending pets on the home screen show what's rising or falling in value.
guides.trading_1: Go to the Trades tab to browse active trade listings from the community.
guides.trading_2: Create your own trade by tapping "+ New Trade" and choosing the items you want to give and get.
guides.trading_3: Chat privately with traders to negotiate — you'll see typing indicators and read receipts.
guides.trading_4: Use the Trade Calculator to check whether a trade is fair before accepting!
guides.trading_5: Use the filter icons at the top of the Trades tab — 👤 My Trades, 👥 Following, 🔖 Saved — to instantly find your own, followed or saved trades.
guides.mystuff_1: 🐾 My Pets — Add the pets you own to see your total portfolio value and demand breakdown.
guides.mystuff_2: ⭐ Goals — Add dream pets to your wishlist and track your progress towards getting them.
guides.chat_1: Tap any user's name to open a private chat and start a conversation.
guides.chat_2: You'll see "typing..." in the header when the other person is writing a message.
guides.chat_3: Grey ✓✓ means your message was delivered. Blue ✓✓ means the other person has seen it.
guides.chat_4: Send images, share pets and use quick message templates for fast replies.
guides.chat_5: Long-press any message to copy, translate or report it.
guides.rating_1: Open a private chat with any user and exchange at least 3 messages each.
guides.rating_2: Once you've both sent 3 messages, the ⭐ Rate button appears at the top of the chat.
guides.rating_3: Tap the stars to give a 1–5 rating, add a written review if you like, then submit.
guides.rating_4: You can change your rating anytime by tapping the ⭐ Edit Rating button.
guides.rating_5: Honest ratings help the community find trustworthy traders and stay safe!
guides.badges_1: Earn XP by logging in daily, rating traders, completing trades and posting.
guides.badges_2: Badges are awarded when you hit milestones — for example 5 trades, 100 messages or 25 reviews.
guides.badges_3: Your badges are shown on your profile for everyone to see.
guides.badges_4: Higher-tier badges (Pro, Elite) take more activity to earn — keep going!
guides.badges_5: Daily login streaks give bonus XP — don't break your streak!
guides.profile_1: Tap the edit icon in Settings to change your display name, bio and profile picture.
guides.profile_2: Add your owned pets and wishlist so other traders know what you have and what you want.
guides.profile_3: Other users can see your profile by tapping your name in any chat.
guides.profile_4: Your rating, badges, XP level and trade history are all visible on your profile.
guides.profile_5: Follow traders you trust so you can easily find them later in the Following list.
guides.safety_1: Never share your Roblox password or login details with anyone.
guides.safety_2: If a deal sounds too good to be true, it probably is — be careful.
guides.safety_3: Always complete trades with the official trading system inside the game.
guides.safety_4: Report suspicious users by long-pressing their message and choosing "Report".
guides.safety_5: Check a trader's rating and reviews on their profile before trading with them.

community_rules.title: Community Chat Rules
community_rules.rule_1: Always communicate respectfully. Hate speech, discrimination and harassment are strictly prohibited.
community_rules.rule_2: Don't share offensive, explicit or inappropriate content, including text, images or links.
community_rules.rule_3: Don't share personal, sensitive or confidential information such as phone numbers, addresses or financial details.
community_rules.rule_4: Spamming, repeating the same message, or promoting products or services without permission is not allowed.
community_rules.rule_5: If you see inappropriate behavior, use the report or block tools in the app.
community_rules.rule_6: Use appropriate language in the chat. Avoid abusive or aggressive tones.
community_rules.rule_7: Discussions or activities that promote illegal or unethical behavior are prohibited.
community_rules.rule_8: You are responsible for the content you share and must follow the community guidelines.
community_rules.rule_9: Moderators can monitor the chat and take action on any violation, including warnings or bans.
community_rules.rule_10: Content must be suitable for all age groups allowed to use the app.
community_rules.rule_11: Don't share links to harmful sites, malware or malicious content.
community_rules.rule_12: By using the chat, you agree to the app's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: {{url}}

guide.title: Groups Guide
guide.create_step_1: 1. Go to the main Chat screen and tap the plus icon (+) in the header.
guide.create_step_2: 2. Select members from the online users list. Tap users to select more than one.
guide.create_step_3: 3. Tap the "Create" or "Add" button at the top. It shows "Create" if you don't have a group yet, or "Add" if you already have one.
guide.create_step_4: 4. If you are creating a new group, enter a group name (required, up to 50 characters) in the window that appears.
guide.create_step_6: 6. The members you selected will get an invitation to join your group.
guide.rule_one_group: Each user can only be the admin/creator of one group at a time.
guide.rule_min_members: A group must have at least 2 members (including you).
guide.rule_max_members: Each group can have up to 50 members.
guide.rule_admin: The creator is the admin. Admins can remove members and make other members admin.
guide.rule_transfer: If an admin (not the creator) makes another member admin, they go back to being a regular member. The creator always stays admin.
guide.rule_leaving: Members can leave at any time. If an admin/creator leaves, a new admin is picked at random. If the last member leaves, the group is deleted.
guide.rule_invites: Members must accept an invitation before they can join.
guide.feature_messages: Send text messages, images, and pets (up to 18 pets per message).
guide.feature_online: See who's online in your group.
guide.feature_roles: View group members and their roles.
guide.feature_notifications: Get notifications for new messages when you're not in the chat.
